reviewer_statement: A provisional developer-reviewed native R scientific plotting contract on a genuine simulated functional result. Numeric source artists have pinned Python 1.2 comparisons in committed tests, but successful exact-head CI has not yet been observed, and native R cannot return Matplotlib Axes or provide runtime class parity. This is not independent full-domain certification.
native_language_semantic_policy: Native R scientific geometry is source-aligned on accepted simulated truth and original observations. Source plot semantics for numeric zero-based indices, finite scatter masks, phase-warp line order and population variance are implemented in strict mode. Python plotting Axes identity, Matplotlib rendering bytes and exception classes are excluded.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_functional_simulation_curve. Genuine native functional simulation latent truth vs original observed values under source zero-based curve and coordinate selection, including plotted missing-by-design points when requested.

Strict source geometry requires actual native etr_functional_simulation_result with validated dense or irregular observation arrays, native truth grid, original observation schedule and missingness audit; source curve and dimension numeric indices are zero based and default zero, or recorded name strings. Non-strict native R backward-compatible indices remain one based. No Python ax injection or Matplotlib runtime identity is implied.

Actual simulated latent_on_truth_grid[curve,:,dimension] is rendered as line; exact original times and finite dense observed values are scatter offsets, with optional removed/missing pre-truth observed points. No fitted interpolation replaces true latent function. Direct pinned Python 1.2 public plot artist line and scatter get_ydata/get_offsets and title comparisons use actual native functional simulation draws, and source curve index zero. Tests committed but not observed passing CI.

Strict rejects fabricated nonnative simulation class, invalid zero-based/out-of-range curve and channel identifiers, unsupported missingness structure, nonlogical strict flag and nonfinite required truth values. R native error classes are not Python TypeError/IndexError/KeyError. Plotting axes injection is omitted.

Source Python returns one Matplotlib Axes with one latent line and observed scatter, plus optional removed/missing scatter. Native R returns one-panel source-scientific line and scatter artist data with correct source labels, title, coordinates and curve selection. Actual Python Axes object, exact renderer state and mutation semantics are not provided.

Visual validation of simulated latent functional truth against actual sampled and missing-by-design observed measurements for the selected original simulation curve and named scientific channel, never resampled at a different grid.
